title: Housemates
blurb: Dishes, bins, dodgy fridge thieves and whoever never buys toilet paper.

questions.text: Who in this house would be most likely to leave one dirty fork in the sink for a week?
Who would be most likely to eat food with someone else's name on it?
Who is most likely to shrink a jumper in the wash and blame the machine?
Who has the worst taste in music for the shared speaker?
Who would be most likely to take the bins out only once the bag is overflowing?
Who would lose a fight with the shower temperature?
Who among us is most likely to use the last of the toilet paper and say nothing?
Who would be most likely to throw a surprise housewarming for forty people?
Who do you reckon is most likely to burn dinner and open every window instead of confessing?
Who's the one most likely to hoard a cupboard of things they swear they'll use one day?
Who would be most likely to leave the heater on all day and wonder about the bill?
Who is most likely to start the house group chat and then mute it?
Who would cry first on the day the lease ends and we all go separate ways?
Who would be most likely to adopt a pet without asking the landlord?
Who is most likely to rearrange the lounge room at midnight?
Who would lose the spare key and swear it was never there?
Who would be the first to lock themselves out wearing only a towel?
Who among us is most likely to cook a feast for the house on a random Wednesday?
Who would be most likely to leave a passive-aggressive note on the fridge?
Who do you reckon is most likely to sleep through a smoke alarm?
Who's the one most likely to label every item in the fridge, down to the butter?
Who would be most likely to win the biggest bedroom by sheer persistence?
Who is most likely to say they'll do the dishes tomorrow and mean it every time?
Who would be most likely to stack takeaway containers into a tower and call it storage?
Who would have a meltdown over a missing remote?
Who among us is most likely to work from the couch in pyjamas for three days straight?
Who would be most likely to invite a mate to "stay a few days" that becomes three months?
Who do you reckon is most likely to give the house spider a name?
Who's the one most likely to knock on a housemate's door at 1am just to chat?
Who would be most likely to flood the bathroom without knowing how?
Who is most likely to try a DIY repair and make it far worse?
Who would take a house games night way too seriously?
Who would be most likely to leave washing in the machine until it needs a second wash?
Who would buy a kitchen gadget and use it exactly once?
Who among us is most likely to build a blanket fort in the lounge?
Who would be most likely to get the whole house hooked on a terrible reality show?
Who do you reckon is most likely to take a loud phone call in the hallway at 7am?
Who's the one most likely to haggle over the internet bill down to the cent?
Who would be most likely to wear a housemate's dressing gown like it's theirs?
Who is most likely to name the sourdough starter and grieve when it dies?
Who is the house parent who reminds everyone about rent?
Who would be most likely to have a guest sneak out the front door at dawn?
Who would have housemates hear far too much through a thin wall?
Who among us is most likely to date a housemate's friend and make dinner awkward?
Who would be most likely to borrow a housemate's shirt for a date and never return it?
